title: Box execution
description: The optional, shell-free application entry point shared by a scroll, the signed release, and box.json. Its absence means the box is intentionally library-only.

oneOf.title: Python script
oneOf.description: Run one regular payload file with the box's own Python interpreter.

script.description: Safe path to a regular Python file inside the box.

oneOf.title: Python module
oneOf.description: Run an importable dotted module with Python's -m option.

module.description: Strict Python dotted-module name, without command-line syntax or shell fragments.

defaultArgs.description: Arguments placed before caller-supplied arguments. Every item is passed directly without a shell.

payloadPath.description: A forward-slash path inside the box payload: relative, non-empty, and unable to escape the payload root.
